meta_description:
514 likes, 21 comments - peterattiamd on October 25, 2026: "Peter’s current thoughts on rapamycin 

This clip is from “Ask Me Anything” episode # 90 (Ep. # 411) of The Drive which was released on 10/12/26.

In the full episode, we cover:

-Why Peter still considers the ketogenic diet an effective tool in the right context—but no longer for the reason he once believed
-What Peter learned after three years of regular extended fasting, how it changed his view of fasting as a longevity intervention, and who may still benefit from prolonged fasts
-How GLP-1 agonists are changing the way people lose weight, and the guardrails Peter considers essential for using them
-Why Peter is less bullish on rapamycin than he once was, and how unresolved questions around dosing have changed the way he thinks about its use in humans
-How the latest evidence on liquid biopsies has—and hasn’t—changed Peter’s thinking, and why he still considers the technology far from proven
-How Peter’s thinking on Zone 2 has evolved over the years, particularly how the amount of time someone has to train changes the way he would prescribe it
-How Peter’s thinking on squats and deadlifts has evolved, when they still make sense, and when other exercises may offer a better risk-reward tradeoff
-Much more

This AMA episode (Ep. # 411) is available exclusively for premium members. Become a member now to watch or listen on my website or your favorite podcast player.".
